$comment: The art mapping: which shipped GLB each visible thing uses, at what scale. Consumed by PropModels/ResolveModels; the primitive builders remain the permanent per-slot fallback, so a missing or broken file degrades that one thing to a primitive instead of breaking boot (D44). Scales are applied and baked at load time, so retuning a silhouette is an edit here, not a pipeline re-run.
$comment_props: Per family: variant list, first entry is the one the batcher uses today (one mesh per family is the PropBatcher contract). The extra variants ship so the judge-loop fix for 'every tree looks the same' is a batcher upgrade, not an asset hunt. `scale` normalises each kit model to the world size the primitives established; heights measured post-merge.
$comment_later: buildings, stations, characters and pals are appended by their phases; the schema test only validates sections that exist and are non-empty.
